# WD10 · Nhóm khách · chưa có khách trong nhóm

Group **WD · CSKH & theo dõi** · state · Next.js: **built (U7)** (`/crm`) · account `owner-tam`

## Logic source
- Old web: `prototype/shared/crm-ui.js#handle`
- CSKH screens are drawn by `crm-ui.js` (queue, task and expected-date dialogs, protocol, activity, segments); commands live in `crm-automation.js` (`PemaCRM`).
- `crm-ui.js › handle()` `segment`: the modal is titled with `C.stageLabels[id]` and lists the patients of that lifecycle stage ("Mở hồ sơ") or the text "Chưa có khách trong nhóm."
- Inventory note: Lifecycle stage with no patient (Đã quay lại sau CSKH; "Khách mới" and "Khách quay lại" are empty too).
- Page key `dashboard` is allowed for roles: owner, doctor (`staff-context.js` › pages). Shown here with account `owner-tam`.
- Capabilities (`staff-context.js` › capabilities): clinical: owner/doctor; crm: owner/care/doctor; booking: owner/care/doctor; billing: owner/accountant; config: owner; readFinance: owner/accountant/doctor.
- No control on this screen is removed by a capability check.
- How to reach it in the old web: {"goto":"/clinic-web/?staff={role}"} → {"click":".sidebar [data-nav=\"dashboard\"]"} → {"click":"[data-crm=\"segment\"][data-id=\"reactivated\"]"} → {"wait":".modal"}; it must show "Chưa có khách trong nhóm.".

## Layout (top to bottom, region → src/ui component)
Every field, action, status, filter and text of the old screen is listed; rows and cards that repeat show the first one with demo values and their count. `old="…"` is the old CSS class, `// key=value` the old `data-*` hook that carries the behaviour.
```tsx
// opens over the page; the backdrop and the page behind it are not part of this screen
<Dialog old="modal crm-modal" title="Đã quay lại sau CSKH" close={{"label":"Đóng hộp thoại"}} aria-label="Đã quay lại sau CSKH">
  <Text>"Chưa có khách trong nhóm."</Text>
</Dialog>
```
Kit components used: Dialog×1. Everything else (Row, Grid, Stack, Text, Heading, Progress, Avatar, Facts, Repeat, Cell…) is a plain element styled with tokens; W3 turns the recurring ones into web blocks.

## Business rules
- "Khách đặt lịch chưa được tính là đã quay lại. Chỉ ghi nhận quay lại khi check-in sau CSKH." (a booking after CSKH is not a returned patient until a check-in).
- Stages: "Khách mới", "Khách quay lại", "Đang điều trị", "Lâu chưa quay lại", "Đã quay lại sau CSKH"; "Khách mới", "Khách quay lại" and "Đã quay lại sau CSKH" are empty in the demo.

## Differences from the app design
- The app (I1) has no lifecycle segment dialogs.

## Gotchas
- Every CSKH dialog uses `crm-modal` with its own `#crm-error` line; errors of the commands are shown there, not in a toast.
